purpose: Teach: 伯/持ち帰っ/さきほど/面倒くさい/無制限/危うく/浮かば/軽快

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの伯母さんから、お土産、もらってきたよ、本気で、嬉しい、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Sho, my aunt brought me back a souvenir and I'm genuinely so happy about it—I really am, I mean it.
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious enthusiasm. A little breathless—Mei is genuinely delighted and wants to share that joy. Warm cadence, no performance, just honest warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お弁当、本気で、持ち帰ったよ、ママに、見せたいんだ、絶対、本気で、本当に、嬉しい、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, she gave me a bento box to bring home. I really want to show it to Mom—I do, I'm so excited about it.
lines.style: Small voice, bright with genuine excitement. Quick, eager pace. Slight pause before saying what he really wants. The kind of pure enthusiasm only a six-year-old can have—no filter, no irony.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: さきほど、お母さんから、メイ姉さんに、メッセージ、入ってきたよ、翔くん、お母さんに、すぐに、伝えるね。
lines.en: Sho, I got a message from your mom a bit earlier. I'll tell her right away, okay?
lines.style: Calm, reassuring tone. Quiet and present. She's listening to him completely. Gentle downward cadence—the voice of someone making a small promise she intends to keep.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 宿題、本気で、面倒くさいよ、メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、頑張りたいんだけど、絶対、応援、お願い、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, homework is such a pain, and I really do want to try my best, but... will you cheer me on? Please?
lines.style: Small, vulnerable request under the words. A child's hesitation before asking for something he needs. Quiet, hopeful tone. The 'but' lands soft—he's checking if she'll still help him even when things are hard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの愛情、本気で、無制限よ、翔くん、いつでも、絶対、本気で、応援してるからね、約束、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: My love for you is unlimited, Sho. I'm cheering for you no matter what—always. I promise, I really do.
lines.style: Steady, absolute certainty in her voice. No tremor, no doubt. Warm but grounded—this isn't gentle performance, it's bedrock. She means every word. Slight emphasis on 'always' to anchor the promise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今日、ぼく、危うく、本気で、お祭りで、迷子になりそうだったよ、メイ姉さん、心配かけてごめん、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Today at the festival I almost got lost, Mei-sis. I'm sorry I worried you like that.
lines.style: Quiet shame underneath, but he's telling her anyway because it matters. Small, careful words. A six-year-old checking whether she'll still care even when he messes up. Trailing off slightly on the apology—seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 絵を描く時、いいアイディア、本気で、なかなか、浮かばない、メイ姉さんも、翔くんと、本気で、悩むこと、本気で、ある。
lines.en: When I'm drawing, Sho, good ideas don't always come to me either. I worry about it sometimes too—just like you do.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pace. She's meeting him at eye level—not reassuring him as a big sister, but sharing her own struggle. Quiet honesty. A small pause before admitting she worries too—she's being real with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、軽快なステップで、踊る、メイ姉さん、好きなんだ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、また、見たい、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Sho, I love the way you watch me dance with those light, springy steps. I really do—and I'll dance for you again, I promise.
lines.style: Warm, delighted that he's been watching her. A smile in her voice. Present tense—she's dancing for him right now in her mind. Gentle lift at the promise, like a door opening onto something he gets to have again.
